page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores and 80 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-to-core ratio, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. This configuration ensures that each vCPU maps directly to a physical core without hyperthreading, providing predictable compute performance.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 9.6 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating efficient data transfer between the instance and external storage volumes or other network resources.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity and dedicated compute resources without the overhead of hyperthreading. This makes it appropriate for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy caching layers, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
